summary.text: Travis Tranel is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Assembly representing District 49 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his current term as beginning on January 3, 2011.

paragraphs.text: Travis Tranel owned and operated his own dairy farm, Tranel Farms USA, Inc., before taking office, according to Ballotpedia, and is a graduate of Loras College with degrees in economics and finance.
Tranel was assigned to the Agriculture Committee as chair, the Commerce Committee as vice-chair, the Energy and Utilities Committee and the Insurance Committee for the 2025-2026 legislative session.
